original_value: Rail-water transportation is a crucial component of intermodal transportation system. Effective operation of rail-water intermodal transportation requires not only railway network and advanced handling equipment, but also scientific and reasonable transportation organization. In this paper, we first briefly introduced the coordination area and related concepts. Then an inbound container distribution organization model (ICDOM) was established taking into account many factors such as transhipping capacity, network capacity, and importance of containers, in order to minimize the total container-hours in the coordination area, which reflects the efficiency of inbound container distribution organization. Additionally, a genetic algorithm (GA) was developed and the optimization results were evaluated, which showed that both of the model and the algorithm were effective.

result.paraphrase: Rail-water transport is a vital part of intermodal transportation systems. Efficient rail-water intermodal operations require not only a railway network and advanced handling equipment, but also a scientific and rational transport organization. In this paper, we first briefly introduced the coordination area and related concepts. We then built an inbound container distribution organization model (ICDOM) that considered many factors, including transshipping capacity, network capacity, and container importance, to minimize total container-hours in the coordination area, thereby reflecting the efficiency of inbound container distribution organization. In addition, a genetic algorithm (GA) was developed and the optimization results were evaluated, showing that both the model and the algorithm were effective.
